sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Zil & Thungr is an aggressive duo miniboss found in Plains inside Sealed tower.

sections.heading: Attack (Thungr)
sections.text: Swings his club in a 4-meter 70-degree horizontal arc in front of himself (150 Blunt, 100 Tier 2 Chop and 40 Tier 2 Pickaxe damage). This attack can be used within 3 meters of the player every 2 seconds. It has two variations: a regular swing and delayed swing[1].

sections.heading: Rage attack (Thungr)
sections.text: Slams his club into the ground 3 times extending out 4 meters and arcing 60 degrees vertically, stepping forward with each swing (130 Blunt, 100 Tier 2 Chop and 40 Tier 2 Pickaxe damage each). He can do this every 20 seconds when within 6 meters of a player.

sections.heading: Fireball (Zil)
sections.text: Zil shoots a fireball at the player, inflicting the Burning status (20 Blunt and 100 Fire damage). This attack has a 12-second cooldown and can be used when within 20 meters of a player. The fireball travels at 15 meters per second for up to 4 seconds before despawning. It has a spread of 4–20 degrees from the center of his aim.

sections.heading: Protect (Zil)
sections.text:
Casts a protective barrier over all allies within a 6-meter radius, negating up to 100 damage before breaking or lasting for up to 40 seconds. This ability has a 40-second cooldown and can be used within 60 meters of a player.
When Thungr is killed, Zil is left alone and his attack pool is reverted to that of a regular Fuling shaman.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
• Zil & Thungr are the first creatures in Valheim that work as a duo.
• Even though they are supposed to be fought as a duo, players can spawn them separately thanks to their Internal IDs. Zil's Internal ID is GoblinShaman_Hildir Thungr's Internal ID is GoblinBrute_Hildir
• Zil is the one that drops Hildir's bronze chest.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text:
• According to their trophy descriptions, Zil is older than Thungr, despite the former's size being smaller than the latter.
• Zil & Thungr have an envy of each other. Zil is jealous of Thungr's strength, and Thungr is jealous of Zil's magical power.
• Inspiration for this duo may originate from the characters "Master Blaster" in the 1985 movie "Mad Max: Beyond Thunderdome".
• Zil can still cast his elemental attacks while swimming.
• When spawning Thungr with cheats, his corpse is the normal green, instead of blue.
• Summoned starred variants of Thungr are brown, where as Zil's stay true to his normal color.
